title: Innovation Painters vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Innovation Painters and Precision Paint Experts for limewash, Venetian plaster, or metallic finishes? What to ask before a decorative paint project.
h1: Innovation Painters vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Decorative finishes add texture and depth that flat paint cannot. This guide covers how to compare bids for limewash, Venetian plaster, and metallic work.

questions: What is the difference between limewash and regular paint?
How do I compare quotes for decorative finishes?

sections.h2: When the finish is the feature
body: Innovation Painters is one of the painting and property-service companies homeowners in North Central Florida may be comparing. If you are considering a decorative finish such as limewash on a fireplace, Venetian plaster in an entry, or a metallic accent wall, the comparison is about technique and expectations as much as price. Decorative work is hand-applied, and no two walls turn out exactly alike, which is part of the appeal.

That variation also makes these projects harder to compare on paper. Two bids for a Venetian plaster entry may describe very different numbers of layers, levels of burnishing, or sealers, and the difference may not be obvious until the work is done. Asking specific questions up front closes that gap.
This guide does not describe anyone else's decorative work. It explains the finishes, suggests questions to ask, and outlines what Precision Paint Experts provides.

Limewash creates a soft, mottled, chalky look with natural variation, popular on brick, masonry, and feature walls. Venetian plaster is built up in thin layers and can be burnished to a polished, stone-like depth. Metallic finishes add shimmer and reflectivity, often used for accent walls, ceilings, or commercial spaces where a little drama helps.
Each behaves differently over time and on different substrates, so ask any bidder why a particular finish suits your surface. Our decorative and faux finishes page shows how we approach each one.

A small swatch on a screen cannot show how light moves across texture, so ask every bidder how you will preview the finish before it goes on the wall. For color, we use full-size drawdowns you can review in your own lighting, and we can match from a chip, a cabinet door, or a leftover can. If you want help pulling the palette together, our color consultation service can help.

sections.h2: Questions for a decorative finish bid
bullets: Will I see a sample on a board before work begins?
What products and how many layers are planned?
How is the surface prepared, and does it need repairs first?
How should the finish be cleaned and maintained?
Is the finish suitable for this room's moisture and traffic?

body: Our estimate lists the surfaces included and excluded, prep steps, products, number of coats or layers, and the schedule. Low-VOC options are available. Any wall repairs needed beforehand, such as patching through our drywall repair service, are listed too. Nothing is added later without written approval, and anything not right at the final walkthrough is fixed before the job is closed out. For interior rooms around a decorative feature, see our interior painting page.

Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the itemized estimate usually follows within one business day. Compare it against other decorative bids layer for layer and product for product, and ask each contractor how they plan to protect the finished feature while surrounding walls are painted.

faqs.q: Can limewash be used inside the house?
faqs.a: Yes. Limewash is often used on interior feature walls and fireplaces as well as on exterior masonry. We will discuss whether it suits your surface during the walkthrough.

faqs.q: Can you match a decorative finish color to something I already have?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match color from a chip, a cabinet door, or a leftover can, and show full-size drawdowns before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you also paint the surrounding walls?
faqs.a: Yes. Decorative work and standard interior painting can be quoted together on one estimate.
